description: Organize observations into a winter checklist, prioritizing reported damage or unusual heaviness.

bottom_seal_gap.description: Gaps under the door or a worn bottom seal

closing_problem.description: The door reverses, stops or will not close normally

new_noise.description: A new grinding, scraping or jerking movement

only_vehicle_access.description: No other entrance to the garage

visible_damage.description: A crooked door, loose cable, visible spring break or unusual heaviness

name: plan_winter_readiness
title: Plan garage-door winter preparation
